scope: Offline deployment interface only; no controller connection or motion authorization
baseline_source: User/main supplied live read-only CPS controller readbacks at LAN 192.168.3.12; this adapter made no connection
reference_acceleration_basis: User requested half of previous 20 deg/s2 reference cap; controller settings unchanged
percentage_denominator: One application velocity base: executor max_velocity_deg=60; controller-reported joint limits remain independent upper bounds

baseline.selection_evidence: Explicit user selection of live HRIF_ReadJointMaxVel baseline; not an independent physical maximum-speed test
baseline.acceleration_selection_evidence: Live HRIF_ReadJointMaxAcc; unchanged as requested, not increased or independently speed-tested

retiming.method: Limit-based timing of the accepted geometric path, resampled at the fixed servo period
retiming.acceleration_policy: Separate explicit usable acceleration constraints; velocity percentages do not define acceleration percentages
retiming.phase_transition: Rest boundary or continuous time-law transition; no abrupt nonzero-velocity scale switch
